name: lwh
description: Companion to the LEAPWare Helm Claude Code plugin, now with the same enforcement: an engine identical to it, an enforcing PreToolUse hook (hooks/hooks.json), and lwh-config/lwh-report skills.

interface.longDescription: lwh makes an AI coding session's spend rules mechanical. Both the Claude Code and Codex plugins enforce via a PreToolUse hook backed by the same lwh_core policy engine, with lwh-config and lwh-report skills for inspecting and previewing policy.
interface.defaultPrompt: lwh: show the current token policy and report on the last action.
